items.title: Fix errors in and clarify the lowest-accuracy questions
items.summary: I reviewed the 10 questions with the lowest accuracy in the GA4 answer data (2026-09-20 to 2026-11-20, questions with at least 20 answers). Five of them have errors in the question itself: more than one correct answer,…

items.title: Set 1: correct answers are heavily skewed toward option B
items.summary: In Mock Exam - Set 1, the correct answer is option B for 62 out of 90 questions (~69%). Test-takers can notice the pattern and pick B without really knowing the answer, which makes the exam less useful as practice.
